scope: Generic protocol plus parent-only structural/source-quote, lossless packet, same-entry literal-citation and merge/validate tooling. Semantic requested-fact correctness, relevance and actual reader grading remain outside this review.
protocol_verdict: PASS: generic, identical except role/path, blind, full-bank, individual short-exact-fact ledgers, minimal explicit case computations and complete selected sections with needed cross-reference following.

prior_findings.evidence: Nontext, empty and whitespace-only supporting quotes now fail; a covered part still requires a valid nonempty quote.

V5 explicitly declares case_conclusions a plain-string array; nested objects raise ValueError for format review while the complete raw source remains preserved. No grade cap or synthetic final result is written.
Same-entry substantive_strings validation is unconditional. All four substantive locations passed independently without any clarification marker.
raw_entries validates original order/count/uniqueness before indexing, is called by prepare and merge, and merge additionally compares each full packet raw entry with the original.

synthetic_testing.method: Only the four authorized source files were read. Checker/tool code ran in isolated namespaces; fact-check functions used an injected allowed base checker, avoiding imported bytecode writes. All synthetic source/question/answer/grade/packet/result data and filesystem operations were in-memory objects/dictionaries. No fixture or real output files were read or written.
